[PREFERENCE] User likes the Enchanted Garden theme for the baby shower.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested displaying family reunion photos in a timeline format, using a mix of photos, captioning them, choosing a display method, highlighting special moments, keeping it simple, and making it interactive.
